block-guide: CORE/TERM-TEMPLATE The repeated part of core/terms-query: its inner blocks are drawn once per term. It lives only inside core/terms-query; see core/terms-query for the structure and full markup. MARKUP: comments only, no HTML of its own: <!-- wp:term-template {"layout":{"type":"grid","columnCount":3}} --> <!-- wp:term-name {"isLink":true} /--> <!-- /wp:term-template --> Rendered as <ul class="wp-block-term-template"> with one <li class="wp-block-term …"> per term. Layout: none = a list, {"type":"grid","columnCount":N} = a grid. No pagination exists.
